stage: Revision-stage supplementary secondary performance analysis; not original-study prespecification
model_rules: Use saved original outer-training transformations, coefficients and selected radiomics development, with original baseline Cox alpha=0.1 and Breslow ties. No selection, tuning or coefficient fitting. Reconstruct Breslow baseline from exact original training rows (including bootstrap multiplicities). Verify saved held-out linear predictors and point-run survival probabilities.
point_estimator: Original point run 0, seed 20261014, five grouped outer folds. AUC/Brier/IBS = unweighted arithmetic mean of the five fold metrics, matching the existing time-metric reporting aggregation within one repeat. All five folds required. Calibration = five-quantile grouped error in pooled patient-level OOF probabilities from this same run.
sensitivity: Ten point repeats reported separately as mean and SD across ten run statistics; never attach single-repeat bootstrap CIs to their mean. Previously reported patient-averaged ten-repeat calibration and variable-window IBS retained as historical descriptive sensitivity.
bootstrap: Original 500 full-development patient bootstrap runs, seeds 20261015..20261514, original draw rows and grouped folds. Both models use the same draws, folds and evaluation patients. Reconstruct saved fits; percentile 2.5/97.5 quantiles (numpy linear method) of paired per-run statistics. Approximate internal randomized-CV uncertainty, not external performance of the final fixed formula.
auc: Cumulative/dynamic IPCW AUC using training-only reverse Kaplan-Meier censoring distribution and scalar Cox linear risk. Cases: death at/before t; controls: survival/censoring time > t. Weighted case-control concordance, 0.5 credit within 1e-8 risk ties. No cases or controls -> NA.
brier: IPCW survival Brier = n^-1 sum[I(T<=t,event)*S(t)^2/G_train(T) + I(T>t)*(1-S(t))^2/G_train(t)]. Training reverse-KM handles event/censoring ties as scikit-survival 0.23.1. Predictions are true survival probabilities, not scores. Times before the first validation observation are mathematically evaluable (all are known event-free); the explicit formula avoids the library wrapper lower-follow-up bound. Verify equality to library on its supported domain.

ibs.normalization: Trapezoidal integral of IPCW Brier over monthly 1..36 divided by 35 months. Same fixed grid for both models, all folds and all repeats. Distinct from the original fold-specific-window descriptive IBS.
ibs.support_basis: Before new metrics: all 2550 training maxima exceed 67 months, validation maxima exceed 37 months; all G_train(36)>0 (minimum0.6875). Monthly1..36 therefore supports the planned horizon without comparing model performance.

censoring_and_support: No censor-weight truncation or clipping. Require finite G>0 at every required event time and t; t strictly below training and validation maximum follow-up. Unsupported censoring or follow-up -> NA reason; no seed replacement. Brier may be evaluated with zero cases if follow-up support exists. AUC requires >=1 case and >=1 control.
calibration: Use same run OOF survival probabilities; event probability=1-S(t). Five quantile groups via pandas qcut with duplicate cutpoints dropped; fewer than five groups -> grouped-error NA. Duplicate bootstrap copies retain their multiplicities and identical predictions, so they cannot straddle training/validation or be arbitrarily split across groups. Group observed event risk =1-KM(t), log-log Greenwood95% CI in original point run. Report n, unique n, events through t, total events, at risk at t, maximum follow-up and boundary intervals. If group follow-up ends before t while KM survival remains >0 -> NA; KM reaching zero by t is estimable with explicit boundary limitation. Group intervals describe observed risk conditional on grouping, not full development uncertainty.
calibration_error: Both original formulas retained: unweighted mean of five absolute(mean predicted risk - KM risk) errors, and n-weighted mean. Compute within each original bootstrap run and then percentile CIs; paired B-A. All five groups in both models must be evaluable for paired inference.
ci_rule: Report each A, B and paired B-A on the common evaluable bootstrap set for that metric/time. CI only if point run 0 is evaluable and >=450/500 joint bootstrap replicates (90%) evaluable; otherwise retain point estimate where possible and explicitly report CI not reliably estimable. List all NA reasons/counts; this operational threshold is not a theorem about coverage.
exception_rule: Non-evaluable statistical quantities are NA with reason. Any unexpected program exception produces a structured failure entry (run, seed, fold, hashes, traceback), nonzero exit and FAILED/PARTIAL state; no COMPLETE marker. All510 original tasks must be attempted and recorded. No adverse repeats dropped and no regenerated seeds.
protected: Original inputs, models, medical decisions, masks, 510 checkpoints, C-index result and published v1.0.0 unchanged. No habitat results, no new predictors, no refitting/tuning for significance. New code candidate remains local.
verification: Strict original draw/fold identity and no leakage; probability range and monotonicity; saved probability/risk agreement; independent IPCW formula versus sksurv on its valid domain and controlled examples; paired percentile recomputation; fixed grid; NA/exception ledger consistency; completeness gate; before/after source SHA.
